title: Politeness and Softening Requests
goal: Combine the polite imperfect with diminutives to soften spoken requests naturally

items: I can combine the polite imperfect (*quería*, *venía*, *llamaba*) with diminutives to soften requests.
I can use softening diminutives like *un momentito*, *un favorcito*, *despacito* and *cerquita* naturally.
I can judge when diminutive politeness fits spoken register and when to avoid it in formal writing.
